defects.description: The rise from ~80 to >350 million tonnes is called 'more than a tenfold increase', but 350 divided by 80 is about 4.4 — more than fourfold, not tenfold.
paraphrases: 350 divided by 80 is about 4.4, so it is a fourfold, not tenfold, increase.
A tenfold rise from 80 million would be 800 million, not 350 million.
The stated growth multiple is far too high for 80-to-350.
defects.rationale: Correct phrasing 'more than a fourfold' (350/80). Findable from the two tonnage figures, distinct.

defects.description: Poultry is said to be 'more than a third' of the 350 million tonne total but 'about 40 million' tonnes; 40 million is only about a ninth of 350 million, not a third.
paraphrases: 40 million out of 350 million is roughly a ninth, not more than a third.
More than a third of 350 million would be over 115 million, not 40 million.
The poultry tonnage and its stated share disagree.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'about 120 million' (more than a third of 350). Findable from the total, distinct.

defects.description: With Asia up about 15-fold and Europe roughly doubled, Asia grew about seven times as fast as Europe, but the text says 'about three times as fast'.
paraphrases: 15-fold versus twofold is about seven times, not three.
The Asia-to-Europe growth ratio is understated.
Dividing a 15-fold rise by a twofold rise gives about 7.5, not 3.
defects.rationale: Correct phrasing 'about seven times as fast' (15/2). Findable from the two regional multiples, distinct.
